tools.name: get_products
tools.description:
Get today's price, pack size, stock and delivery time for specific NB8 Floral products by
    slug, optionally in a given color.

tools.name: identify_flowers
tools.description:
Identify the flower types and colors in a photo given by public image URL, and match each
    to NB8 Floral products. Stem counts are approximate.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description:
Create a one-time link to a cart on nb8floral.com pre-filled with the given products.
    Nothing is charged: the cart is reviewed and paid on nb8floral.com. Quantities are rounded up
    to whole packs and prices are recalculated from today's data. The link works once and expires
    after 30 minut

tools.name: create_quote_request
tools.description:
Save a product list for a price quote (pre-order items, large or custom orders, or
    shipping outside the contiguous US) and return an order code like NB8-7K3QX. Nothing is
    ordered or charged; the code is sent to NB8 Floral by email or WhatsApp to receive a quote.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_quote_request · Public sink: create_quote_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_quote_request · Public sink: create_quote_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
